releases.title: Original cameras with Stadium alternatives
releases.summary: Eleven classic cars receive the tested original camera defaults and Stadium alternative cameras.

changes.title: Camera choices for all cars
changes.description: The managed car release includes original Cam 1, 2, and 3 plus Stadium Alt Cam 1 and 2 on all eleven classic cars. Trackmania loads changed tunings on the next game start.

changes.title: Keep matching local camera files
changes.description: If your installed camera tuning exactly matches this release, the companion adopts it without replacing it. Unknown local edits still require review.

releases.title: Install updates from the game-start notice
releases.summary: After Trackmania opens, the companion can install a verified update from its desktop notice and show the result.

changes.title: Install from the desktop
changes.description: Choose Install in the update notice to download and verify a newer companion, or to install managed car files when no local changes block them. Not now leaves the game running.

changes.title: Clear completion status
changes.description: The companion confirms its new version after replacement. Car updates report that files are installed and that Trackmania may load changed assets on its next start.

changes.title: Preserve local edits
changes.description: Changed car files, including custom camera tunings, are offered for review instead of being overwritten by the desktop install action.

releases.title: Update notices when Trackmania starts
releases.summary: The desktop companion checks for a newer companion and missing or changed managed cars when Trackmania opens.

changes.title: Desktop update window
changes.description: See release notes when the game starts, then choose to review the update or leave it for later. The notice returns on a later game launch while the update is pending.

changes.title: Car repair reminder
changes.description: The same window points to Repair files when managed car files are missing or changed. Repair still requires confirmation on the website.

releases.title: New factory colours and icons
releases.summary: The eleven managed cars now use the updated factory palette, with matching factory icons and safe upgrades for installed community skins.

changes.title: Updated factory palette
changes.description: Repair files applies the new colours to every classic car while preserving a verified community livery.

changes.title: Matching factory icons
changes.description: Factory, Current, and simple icon DDS files now match the new car colours. Community skin icons remain selected during a compatible update.

releases.title: Car thumbnails beside the ZIPs
releases.summary: Each classic car now has a factory thumbnail, and selecting a community skin updates its current thumbnail for cups and other tools.

changes.title: Three thumbnails for every car
changes.description: Repair files adds Factory, Current, and simple Icon DDS files beside each car ZIP. The manual cars ZIP includes them too.

changes.title: Current icon follows your skin
changes.description: When a selected livery includes Icon.dds, the companion copies it to Current and the simple icon. If it has no usable icon, both use the factory render.

changes.title: Restore the factory icon
changes.description: Restoring one or all factory skins also resets their Current and simple thumbnails.

releases.title: ManiaPark skins and native refresh
releases.summary: Preview real liveries in 3D and apply them with the standalone Windows companion. Native refresh is a development preview; visible next-map results are still being verified.

changes.title: Apply skins at the menu
changes.description: On supported Trackmania builds, a prepared skin waits until you leave the map or editor, then refreshes the game's files for your next map. Openplanet is not required.

changes.title: Reset defaults without restarting
changes.description: Reset one car or all installed cars through the same menu-time refresh. Other game builds retain the close-game fallback.

changes.title: Recover interrupted skin changes
changes.description: Skin files and their installation record are verified and committed together. Original files remain available until completion is confirmed.

changes.title: Previews use the packaged cars
changes.description: The garage now uses the same model files as the installed vehicles, so selected liveries align with the actual car bodies.

changes.title: Matching Coast HD liveries
changes.description: Coast shows liveries for its HD model and correctly combines their paint with the retained secondary details.

releases.title: Updates that reconnect
releases.summary: Shorter download names and a more reliable connection after updating.

changes.title: The update connects again
changes.description: New companions negotiate supported controls with the website, so an older service no longer rejects their connection reports.

changes.title: Short, recognisable filenames
changes.description: Downloads include the version and an eight-character ID. Setup details travel inside the EXE, so renaming the download keeps automatic pairing working.

changes.title: Clear download and reconnect feedback
changes.description: Follow download progress and verification, then reconnect from the update modal if the new version takes longer to appear.

changes.title: Opening a download twice
changes.description: The companion remembers a successful pairing and waits for the previous version to finish closing before replacing it.

releases.title: A fresh coat of factory paint
releases.summary: Restore a car's default colour or reset your whole collection from the car catalogue.

changes.title: Reset all skins
changes.description: The catalogue options menu can restore the packaged defaults for all installed managed cars in one operation.

changes.title: Reset means the actual default
changes.description: Reset downloads the current factory skin, even when the car was already marked as using its default or still had an older default.

changes.title: Clear progress and recovery
changes.description: Review the reset before it starts, follow its progress, and see when it is complete. Interrupted resets preserve the original skins for recovery.

releases.title: Factory colours and a smoother setup
releases.summary: Your classic cars get their catalogue colours, setup is clearer, and future updates appear right here.

changes.title: Real factory colours
changes.description: Eleven classic cars now include their catalogue colours. Use Repair files after updating to apply them to existing cars.

changes.title: Your skins stay yours
changes.description: Repair keeps recognised community skins. Restore factory skin selects the new coloured default.

changes.title: A fresh start when reinstalling
changes.description: Reinstallation waits for the new EXE instead of picking up an old uninstall job or spent connection link.

changes.title: A clearer installation wizard
changes.description: Animated step indicators, a proper progress bar, and explicit game-folder confirmation keep setup easy to follow.

changes.title: Updates on this page
changes.description: The running companion reports its version. When an update is ready, you can read the changes and download it here.
